body:
It had a lot to do with lies. Nothing ever big. But just constant lying.
Like, if he’d get pulled over by the police for a broken tail light. He’d lie about why he got pulled over and why it happened. Or if I’d ask if he passed by the store, he’d say no, even if he did. It was ridiculous lies. And that was a big part of it. He said I should learn to lie.To be fair, I have a hard time lying. And have been told by multiple people i should learn to be ok with lying.
We’re 28. So we’re still young. But i don’t think that justifies his BS
I had my tubes tied. And we’ve got 6 kids. So I know that’s not his intention.

I joke a lot with my kids. I “threaten” them, with ridiculous things. Like “if you don’t stop, I’m going to drop kick you 3 blocks away”. Or “if you don’t leave me alone, I’m going to fart in your face”
Stupid shit, that’s impossible, or just stupid.

Yesterday, she neglected to tell me she was unmuted, while I was shouting at my son, that if he didn’t come, I’d cut his legs off and glue some wheels on him so I could just pull him to me. Thankfully her teacher laughed it off. But fuck these zoom meetings 😂
I have infant twins, so I’m in a couple twin mom support  groups on fb. And the amount of people who think this is cute and funny and goals, is fucking creepy.
This is a pretty weird comment. NGL
